protocol_name: iPSC tri-culture to capsule-based single-cell RNA library: Lysis, RT, split, index PCR, pool and release chip

events.narration: IR step 14 (reaction_trap): load the capsules from the hand-off from chip2_encapsulation_emulsion_break_capsule_wash_curing: syringe on inlet_1 at 20 uL/min, VENT reaction_trap_waste_out. Every other port capped.

IR step 14 (reaction_trap): exchange to lysis_buffer: FEED wash_buffer_in (lysis_buffer) at 20 uL/min, VENT reaction_trap_waste_out, all else capped; 1.5 chamber volumes (75 uL) per wash (default flow). Lyse the cells inside the capsules (placeholder time and temperature).
IR step 14 (reaction_trap): incubate in place: all ports capped, hold 22 C for 10 min (placeholder time). Lyse the cells inside the capsules (placeholder time and temperature).

IR step 15 (reaction_trap): exchange to wash_buffer: FEED wash_buffer_in (wash_buffer) at 20 uL/min, VENT reaction_trap_waste_out, all else capped; 3 chamber volumes (150 uL) per wash x 3 washes (default flow). Wash the capsules after lysis.

IR step 16 (reaction_trap): exchange to rt_mix: FEED inlet_1 (rt_mix) at 20 uL/min, VENT reaction_trap_waste_out, all else capped; 1.5 chamber volumes (75 uL) per wash (default flow). Reverse transcribe the RNA inside the capsules (placeholder time and temperature).
IR step 16 (reaction_trap): incubate in place: all ports capped, hold 42 C for 1 h (placeholder time). Reverse transcribe the RNA inside the capsules (placeholder time and temperature).

IR step 17 (reaction_trap): exchange to wash_buffer: FEED wash_buffer_in (wash_buffer) at 20 uL/min, VENT reaction_trap_waste_out, all else capped; 3 chamber volumes (150 uL) per wash x 2 washes (default flow). Wash the capsules after reverse transcription.

IR step 18 (split_2): split: FEED inlet_1 (carrier_buffer) at 20 uL/min, VENT pcr_1_vent_out, pcr_2_vent_out, pcr_3_vent_out, pcr_4_vent_out, all else capped. Split the capsules into four sublibrary portions.

IR step 19 (pcr_1): exchange to index_mix_1: FEED index_mix_1_in (index_mix_1) at 20 uL/min, VENT pcr_1_vent_out, all else capped; 1.5 chamber volumes (37.5 uL) per wash (default flow). Run index PCR on each sublibrary with its own index (placeholder cycles, times and temperatures).

IR step 19 (pcr_2): exchange to index_mix_2: FEED index_mix_2_in (index_mix_2) at 20 uL/min, VENT pcr_2_vent_out, all else capped; 1.5 chamber volumes (37.5 uL) per wash (default flow). Run index PCR on each sublibrary with its own index (placeholder cycles, times and temperatures).

IR step 19 (pcr_3): exchange to index_mix_3: FEED index_mix_3_in (index_mix_3) at 20 uL/min, VENT pcr_3_vent_out, all else capped; 1.5 chamber volumes (37.5 uL) per wash (default flow). Run index PCR on each sublibrary with its own index (placeholder cycles, times and temperatures).

IR step 19 (pcr_4): exchange to index_mix_4: FEED index_mix_4_in (index_mix_4) at 20 uL/min, VENT pcr_4_vent_out, all else capped; 1.5 chamber volumes (37.5 uL) per wash (default flow). Run index PCR on each sublibrary with its own index (placeholder cycles, times and temperatures).

IR step 19 (pcr_4): thermal cycling on thermocycler (thermal zone pcr_zone), all ports capped: N cycles of 95 °C 15 s / 60 °C 30 s / 72 °C 30 s, after 95 °C 120 s, then 72 °C 5 min and hold 4 °C (placeholder program). Run index PCR on each sublibrary with its own index (placeholder cycles, times and temperatures).
IR step 20 (release_trap): move the capsules from pcr_1 to release_trap: FEED inlet_1 (carrier buffer), VENT release_trap_waste_out. Every other port capped.

IR step 20 (release_trap): release: FEED release_enzyme_in (release_enzyme) at 20 uL/min, VENT outlet_1, all else capped. Release the cDNA from the capsules by digesting the shell with a shell-digesting enzyme (placeholder time and temperature).
IR step 24 (pool_2): pool: FEED inlet_1 (library_suspension) at 20 uL/min, VENT outlet_1, all else capped. Pool the four cleaned-up sublibraries for sequencing.

IR step 24 (pool_2): collect the library: FEED inlet_1 (buffer push), VENT outlet_1 into a tube labelled 'chip3_lysis_rt_split_index_pcr_pool_release: library after step 24, for chip4_bead_binding_wash_elution inlet_1'. Every other port capped.
